compiled_state.title: mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh drops 1 of 3 records under exotic-byte defense_text (backticks, code fences, embedded quotes)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Reproducer
While developing tests/integration/test-mirror-defenses-round-trip.sh during the SDET audit (P1-3, PR #237), the round-trip test with three defense records carrying tricky bytes consistently leaked one record:

```
record 1: defense_text='backticks: ``` pipes: || brackets: [x](y)'  → SURVIVED
record 2: defense_text='code fence ~~~json {"k":"v"} ~~~'           → DROPPED
record 3: defense_text='embedded JSON quotes "nested" and apostrophe' → SURVIVED
```

Only 2 of 3 records round-tripped through write → `gh pr comment` (stub) → `gh pr view --json comments` (stub) → JSON parse.

## Where
- Producer: `plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` → `review_mirror_defenses_to_pr` (review-github-defense-store.sh:91)
- Consumer: `runner.py _normalize_cited_ref` / arbiter dispatcher reading PR-comment bodies

## Root-cause hypothesis (unconfirmed)
Either:
(a) The DEFENSE_RECORD JSON containing markdown-special sequences gets escaped/altered by `gh pr comment`'s body handling and isn't recoverable on parse.
(b) `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` strips/transforms the JSON before posting.
(c) The stdin line-reading loop in `review_mirror_defenses_to_pr` (review-github-defense-store.sh:102) mishandles records with embedded backticks.

## Why it matters
Defense records are the canonical mechanism for autonomous review-cycle convergence (CLAUDE.md rule 11). A defense that round-trips lossily means R5 resolution may silently lose the cycle's defended findings, forcing redundant fix attempts or user escalation.

## Test exists, currently passing baseline only
`tests/integration/test-mirror-defenses-round-trip.sh` round-trips plain-ASCII text and passes 1/1. The exotic-byte stress is deferred (commented inline in the test file). Driving the stress case to GREEN requires fixing this bug.

## Reproducer to add post-fix
Re-introduce the original tricky-byte records in `_make_defense_record` calls and assert all 3 survive.

comments.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: review_mirror_defenses_to_pr in review-github-defense-store.sh drops 1 of 3 records when defense_text contains exotic bytes (backticks, code fences, embedded quotes). Likely cause: github_defense_store_write passes JSON body via --body interpolation, breaking on embedded markdown chars. Proposed fix: switch from 'gh pr comment --body "$json"' to --body-file <(cat) or a temp file; re-enable exotic-byte stress in tests/integration/test-mirror-defenses-round-trip.sh. Classification: MODERATE — bounded bash logic fix in one script + un-defer existing stress test. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
